title: Submacroscopic Fourier dependence cannot carry a leading Wick defect

dependence_bound.block_size: Every independent block contains at most b_N real Fourier coordinates.
dependence_bound.finite_bound: If ||e_j||_infinity<=C_e then |D_N|<=K C_e^4 sum_B(sum_(j in B)lambda_j)^2<=K C_e^4 b_N sum_j lambda_j^2.
dependence_bound.profile_bound: For 0<s_j<=S and omega_k=sqrt(m^2+|k|^2), sum_j lambda_j^2<=S^2 sum_k omega_k^(-2)/4=O_(m,S)(N) in three dimensions.
dependence_bound.leading_threshold: If b_N=o(N^3), then D_N=o(N^4); within this block model a leading defect requires b_N=Omega(N^3), the scale of the complete cutoff mode count.
dependence_bound.scope_guard: Macroscopic block size is necessary rather than sufficient; growing standardized cumulants, unbounded covariance profiles, broken central symmetry and non-block correlations remain outside the theorem.
